data.title: Vivy · 缝纫与服装保养
data.description: 休息室，她自己缝补演出服的披风边缘，针脚精准得像机器——本来就是机器；但哼着歌缝衣服的样子，比任何人类都更像「生活」。
data.action: 休息室，她自己缝补演出服的披风边缘，针脚精准得像机器——本来就是机器
data.promptProse: Vivy repairs the edge of her performance cape in the rest room, placing precise stitches while quietly humming. Her cream long-sleeved blouse and comfortable navy trousers remain ordinary, the cape resting across her lap rather than replacing her clothes. The medium portrait includes folded costume fabric and the seat beside her. Lamplight highlights the needle point, blue hair and thread, casting small seam shadows that show the cloth's thickness beneath her careful hands.
